title.narrative: Capacity Building of Student Councils in Moldova and sharing skills between Denmark and Moldova.

description.narrative: This preparatory study is meant to design a new project to build the capacity of the student council in Moldova, where the sharing of skills and experience between Denmark and Moldova will be in focus. During 7 days we want to get to know each other better and visit schools and student councils from Moldova to find out the main challenges they have and what their needs are in the process of their work. After we have a clear vision of what's happening on the local level, we want to start the process of building the capacity of the student councils. We also want to work with teachers and school administration to inform them about the importance of the student councils and to develop strong cooperation between the schools and the student councils. The project is also aiming to develop skills in the students that will manage and work in the student councils. Further on in the project, we want to invite AEGEE Chisinau to Denmark, and show them how our student councils and cooperation from administration to local council works, and what laws we have to prevent misunderstandings in cooperation.
